### Overall Decision

- [ ] **APPROVED** - Concept approved to proceed to detailed architecture design
- [ ] **APPROVED WITH DOMAIN REVIEW** - Concept approved to proceed to Domain Review
- [ ] **APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS** - Concept approved with specific requirements
- [ ] **DEFERRED** - Additional information required before decision
- [ ] **REJECTED** - Concept does not meet requirements or standards

### Required Gates

**Gate Progression Path** (in order):

- [x] **CRB (Conceptual Review Board)** -  COMPLETED - Concept approved
- [x] **DRB (Domain Review Board)** - Security and AI/ML reviews
- [x] **ARB (Architecture Review Board)** - Detailed architecture design review
- [x] **ORT (Operational Readiness Test)** - Production readiness assessment
- [x] **TOPS (Turnover to Operations)** - Go-live approval and operational handoff
- [x] **PPR (Post Project Review)** - Post-implementation review and lessons learned
